newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti chairman De Benedetti to step down - TV.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti chairman De Benedetti to step down - TV.

text.p: Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti is stepping down from his position, Italian television reported on Tuesday.
The state RAI television gave no source for the report, which came after an Olivetti board meeting in Milan.

Company sources confirmed De Benedetti was stepping down as chairman and would be replaced by a member of the board of directors Antonio Tesone, but a spokeswoman for the Olivetti group declined to comment, saying a statement was due later.

Olivetti shares fell more than five percent on the Milan bourse on Tuesday as rumours abounded about the troubled company's financial problems and on talk of conflict between De Benedetti and new managing director Francesco Caio, who took over from Corrado Passera in July.
ANSA news agency later reported that De Benedetti would also leave the Olivetti board.
It said Caio would be in charge of day to day management, while the company was expected to set up an executive committee.
